policy.name: SYNTHETIC — fictional Summary of Benefits and Coverage

clauses.text: Calculation and accumulation rules: For covered care apply any remaining deductible first, then the stated copay, then member coinsurance to the remaining allowed amount. Round coinsurance half up to cents. Apply the remaining annual OOP cap to deductible, copay and coinsurance in that order. Only actually assessed covered sharing accrues. In- and out-of-network annual pools are separate. Permitted excess equals charge minus allowance and is outside OOP. Excluded care is full-charge patient liability outside deductible and OOP, with no insurer payment. No excess billing is allowed in network. A waived deductible means no deductible applies to that benefit.
B1: MRI (CPT/HCPCS 72148), in-network: covered; deductible waived; member copay $0.00; member coinsurance 20%.
